description: This pie chart, from the paper "OpenAssistant Conversations -- Democratizing Large Language Model Alignment," illustrates the distribution of languages used in the dataset, with the largest segment being English at 42.8%, shown in a dark blue slice. The second largest segment is Spanish at 31.4%, depicted in a lighter blue. Following these are Russian at 5.7%, German at 3.6%, French at 2.9%, Chinese at 2.5%, Thai at 1.9%, Portuguese (Brazil) at 1.7%, and a combined "Other" category at 5.8%, which is visually represented by a light gray slice and includes all other languages not individually listed. The chart includes percentage labels directly on each slice and a legend in the upper right corner that identifies the "Other" category. The segments are arranged in descending order of size, starting from the largest (English) and moving clockwise.
